from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """A record extracted from one company's financial report for the given period."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the report belongs to")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The time period of the financial report")
    current_assets_total: float | None = Field(description="The value for 'Total Current Assets' (流动资产合计)")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency of the financial data, typically CNY")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the document containing the asset value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_records: list[CompanyFinancialRecord]
